observations: DFL distribution statistics as predictors of localization quality are established prior art.
DGQP uses four-edge Top-k values and their mean followed by a small learned predictor.
Candidate24 uses fixed action-relative likelihood across shared-weight views, but this difference alone does not establish novelty and its registered signal screen failed.
